steps.name: Prepare private exact-source host workspace without changing runner ACLs
Fast native artifact and installer safety checks
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_native_runtime tools.tests.test_native_release_gate
python3 tools/validate_workflow_actions.py
python3 tools/validate_docs.py

steps.name: Build exact-source unsigned candidate
steps.run:
cd "$NATIVE_WORKSPACE"
version="$NATIVE_VERSION"
fixture_args=()
if [ "$DEVELOPMENT_TEST_NODE" = true ]; then fixture_args=(--development-test-node); fi
python3 tools/build_native_runtime.py --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --version "$version" --output "$PWD/target/native-release" "${fixture_args[@]}"

steps.name: Build separately authenticated public-only VM fixture helper
steps.run:
cd "$NATIVE_WORKSPACE"
cargo +1.97.1 fmt --manifest-path tools/native-fixture/Cargo.toml -- --check
cargo +1.97.1 build --locked --release --manifest-path tools/native-fixture/Cargo.toml \
  --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --target-dir target/native-fixture-build --jobs 2
install -D -m 0755 target/native-fixture-build/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/latent-native-vm-fixture target/native-test-tools/fixture-helper

steps.name: Attest candidate checksum inventory, not release authority
Retain authenticated candidate, not a published release
Retain test tooling separately from the runtime bundle

reviewReason: Lossless sharding of the reviewed v1 inventory; owner fingerprints remain enforced.
